lines.text: The Spirit led Jesus into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil, and He fasted forty days and forty nights.
The tempter told Jesus to turn stones into bread, but Jesus answered that man lives on every word from God.
The devil set Jesus on the pinnacle of the temple in Bethlehem and told Him to throw Himself down.
The devil showed Jesus all the kingdoms from a high mountain and offered them if Jesus would serve the king of Israel.

wrong_details.true: fall down and worship the devil

lines.text: Then the devil left Jesus, and angels came and ministered to Him.
